name: VenueRateConfig
description: Per-venue editable rate sheet. Single source of truth for cover charges, re-entry fees, driver payouts, and bonus tiers. NEVER hardcode any of these values in logic — always read from this entity. Seeded once per venue; admin-editable thereafter.

venue_id.description: Foreign key to Venue. One config per venue.

venue_name.description: Display label only — not used in logic.

cover_charge.description: Standard cover charge in USD. Read by door POS Cover — Cash / Cover — Card buttons.

card_discount.description: Discount applied when guest pays cover by card (affiliated driver formula leg). USD.

driver_payout_affiliated.description: Per-guest payout in USD for affiliated (NUPS-owned) drivers.

driver_payout_outside.description: Per-guest payout in USD for outside / unaffiliated drivers.

applies_when.description: Day of week or event tag

driver_bonus_tiers.description: Editable bonus rules added to driver payout formula. Empty array = no bonus.

cc_processing_fee_rate.description: Credit card processing fee rate applied at the door register only. Door cover charges are sales-tax-exempt; this rate is the pass-through processor fee added when the guest pays cover by card.

house_commission_rate.description: House commission rate for entertainer earnings.

mode.description: Ledger mode. REAL writes to live books; DEMO is sandbox; SANDBOX is dev-only. Door + driver writes must honor this.
